verdict.rationale: The pack shows Orb has API reference pages (error responses, pagination, idempotency, endpoint pages such as create-customer-alert), but nothing shows they are interactive or include runnable examples such as a try-it console or playground. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. A static API reference is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
